system.description: Once learned, every Blood Trait gained from animals counts as two. However, after every third feeding on animal blood, you must win a Static Mental Challenge whenever offered human or Kindred blood or you frenzy and drain the vessel. The difficulty escalates by three extra Traits bid at each subsequent third feeding (sixth, ninth, etc.) until you frenzy and slake your thirst, resetting the count. Does not grant bonus Blood Traits from supernatural creatures in animal form.
system.duration: Permanent, until you frenzy and feed
